topic.title: count_bassed_sum.c
topic.description: It a simple project to get some of numbers with a finite known numbers.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Ask how many numbers, then read exactly that many and keep a running total.
learningNotes.challenges: Neither the count nor the numbers are checked, so the loop can ask for a number that never comes.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Check the count and each number, and say in a comment why the running total starts at zero.

misconceptions: `scanf` returns how many items it read — the value is only ever set if you check that, so a missing answer leaves the variable untouched
A running total has to start at zero, not at the first number, or the first number is counted twice
